# Trendbrott för börsen och stigande inflationsförväntningar

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Börsfrukost episode (17 August 2026) covers a Stockholm market rebounding after a short, mild downtrend. It also covers mixed AstraZeneca phase 3 news, an early turnaround at Kjell & Company, and a Pareto buy initiation on Ellos. Guest Peter Hedlund warns that inflation expectations are rising (Hormuz-driven energy prices, Origo survey) and that OMXS30 looks expensive at about 20x P/E against a 10-year average of about 16. He prefers smaller-cap and defensive mid-cap names that were not lifted by the AI hype, such as Axfood, AAK, Securitas, Kopparbergs, Ambea and Attendo.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 KJELL — Kjell & Company | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Early turnaround: organic growth over 7%, EBITA positive, strong management and owners buying shares.

#### Reasoning

Hosts and guest say Kjell shows it is on the right track after a weak previous quarter. Sourcing problems have eased and product mix and pricing are being reviewed, but costs are still too high and turnarounds take time. A competent ex-Rusta CEO, heavy owners and continued insider buying (Göran Westberg) back the case. No explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if costs are not brought down
- if organic growth stalls
- if margins fall back to losses

> *"Så man visar ändå att man är på rätt väg nu."*

---

### 🟢 ELLOS — Ellos | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Pareto started coverage with a buy. Guest says the stock is not expensive and could re-rate if the next reports confirm progress.

#### Reasoning

The buy call is Pareto's (analyst), not the hosts'. The guest adds that the stock is not expensive and that recent numbers looked decent. After a messy restructuring history and weak trading since the IPO, a few reports showing progress could lift the share price. The next report is due next week.

#### Sell Triggers

- if next week's report disappoints
- if the business fails to show improvement over several reports

> *"Det är inte dyrt heller, så kan man bara bevisa nu några rapporter att det ändå går åt rätt håll så kan det nog börja lättna i aktiekursen också."*

---

### 🟢 EVO — Evolution | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

ABG raised its target price to SEK 1,000, implying 33% upside; stock up 2.5%.

#### Reasoning

Analyst-driven signal: ABG sees 33% upside after raising its target to SEK 1,000. The hosts only report the move and give no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if analysts cut estimates
- if regulatory headwinds increase

> *"Där ser ABG en uppsida på 33 procent när man höjer riktkursen till 1 000 kronor"*

---

### 🟠 AZN — AstraZeneca | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Mixed phase 3 news, pipeline worries and a possible BMS deal; stock down 12% in 3 weeks.

#### Reasoning

Stopping a study as late as phase 3, after an earlier phase 3 failure, raises pipeline concerns. The host wonders whether the BMS talks reflect desperation and notes the risk of lost confidence. Against that, the Tagrisso+Orpathys study was positive and the market reacted mildly (+1%). The sector has also been weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if more phase 3 failures follow
- if a large, value-destroying BMS acquisition goes ahead

> *"Sen kom det här ryktet om att man ska köpa Bryssel-Mairs Squibb och då började jag fundera, finns det en liten desperation här"*

---

### ⛔ SINCH — Sinch | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Co-founder Johan Hedberg keeps selling (about SEK 10m, after SEK 7m earlier in August at SEK 45); stock down 2% to SEK 43.

#### Reasoning

Repeated insider selling by a co-founder is a negative sign. Hosts state the facts without an explicit view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if insider selling stops and fundamentals improve

> *"Där har medgrundaren Johan Hedberg återigen ska vi säga sålt aktier."*

---

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Defensive name punished after a weak report; guest sees valuation support.

#### Reasoning

With OMXS30 at about 20x P/E and rates rising, the guest prefers defensive names that missed the AI hype and have fallen, since their valuations may give support.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings keep weakening
- if the market keeps favouring the AI trade

> *"Jag tror det kanske finns lite stöd i värderingarna hos de mer defensiva bolagen som inte har dragits med i AI-hajpen."*

---

### 🟠 AAK — AAK | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Defensive name punished after a weak report; guest sees valuation support.

#### Reasoning

Same view as Axfood: a defensive mid-cap whose valuation may give support in an expensive market with rising rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings keep weakening

> *"Axfood, AAK, förvisso lämnade de svaga rapporterna men tog rejält med stryk."*

---

### 🟠 SECU-B — Securitas | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Biggest drop in 20 years; defensive valuation support.

#### Reasoning

The guest names Securitas as a defensive company outside the AI hype whose large drop may now leave valuation support.

#### Sell Triggers

- if fundamentals deteriorate further

> *"Securitas, ett annat bolag, störst nedgång på 20 år."*

---

### 🟢 KOBR-B — Kopparbergs | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest calls it cheap and a possible defensive pick despite little information; reports Wednesday.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion: the valuation is cheap and the business defensive, but information is poor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the summer quarter report is weak

> *"Kopparbergs är ändå billigt. Dåligt med information och så men tycker ändå det kan också vara ett defensivt val."*

---

### 🟡 AMBEA — Ambea | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Has done well, buying Humana; guest sees fairly low risk apart from political risk.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion: good momentum and the Humana acquisition make this a reasonably low-risk defensive name. Political risk exists but does not feel imminent.

#### Sell Triggers

- if political risk in welfare services rises
- if Humana integration problems appear

> *"Tycker borde vara hyggligt låg risk. Det finns en politisk risk förstås."*

---

### 🟡 ATT — Attendo | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Has done well; reasonably low risk apart from political risk; reports Thursday.

#### Reasoning

Grouped with Ambea as a low-risk care stock with political risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if political risk in welfare services rises

---

### 🟠 ORK — Orkla | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest finds it interesting; BUBS hype and a SEK 2bn factory, though BUBS is a small part of Orkla.

#### Reasoning

The guest likes Orkla and points to the BUBS brand's hype and knock-on effects (the H&M collaboration sold out). The host questions whether the hype is fading, and BUBS is small relative to the group.

#### Sell Triggers

- if BUBS hype fades
- if the factory investment fails to pay off

> *"Orklar tycker jag är intressant."*

---

### 🟠 KLAR — Klarna | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Reports on NYSE tomorrow; guest finds it interesting given big deals such as the Apple partnership.

#### Reasoning

The guest calls the report quite interesting because of recent large partnerships. No explicit direction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report disappoints

> *"Ja och den är faktiskt ganska intressant för de har tagit några stora avtal här."*
